summary: NewsBlur is a self-hosted feed reader that aggregates news sources and allows users to discuss articles. It provides an alternative way to consume and share web content through RSS and related syndication formats.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small groups who want to self-host their news consumption and social discussion around feeds.
watchOut: Self-hosting feed readers often involves managing background worker processes for continuous polling, which can consume notable resources depending on your subscription volume.
deployNotes: As a Python application, it typically requires a WSGI or ASGI server behind a reverse proxy handling TLS, alongside a relational database and persistent storage for reliable operation.
